summary: Mobile web smoke tested Home, Menu, search, product detail, add-to-cart, Cart, and Profile. Core local flows work, but required backend integrations return 404.

critical.issue: Returns 404; inventory soldOut merge cannot work and Menu shows 'Something went wrong' on every startup/refresh.
Returns 404; real phone OTP sign-in cannot start.
Not implemented in workspace starter backend; checkout/order creation remains unverified and expected to fail.

integration_issues.issue: The UI correctly falls back to bundled menu, but displays a persistent error banner because GET /api/items is unavailable.

action_items: Provide/deploy the requested existing Node/Express DSB backend or implement the required FastAPI routes at the configured public URL.
Retest OTP, coupon, checkout, order history/tracking, delivery confirmation, and reviews after backend routes are available.
critical_code_review_comments: Frontend API client correctly prefixes /api and reads EXPO_PUBLIC_BACKEND_URL, but configured backend exposes only starter routes.
Interactive controls generally meet 44px targets; some controls lack explicit testID attributes, reducing automation coverage.
Auth credentials file contains no usable test credentials; OTP flow was not completed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Preview loaded without a red screen. Home showed bundled menu. Menu contained exactly 10 items with prices; search Chicken filtered correctly; product route and add action worked; cart showed Chicken Noodles subtotal ₹80, delivery ₹10, total ₹90 and badge 1. Profile rendered sign-in UI. Backend logs confirm 404 for /api/items, /api/otp/send, and coupon validation.
rca_of_issue: The frontend calls the configured public URL with /api routes, but backend/server.py is the starter FastAPI scaffold and has no DSB routes (only include_router(api_router)); ingress therefore returns 404. This is an environment/backend implementation mismatch, not a client URL construction failure.
